fact: At the annual review meeting of 25 May 2020 MINEDH reported that its online school management platform was designed in 2018 and began as a pilot in 2019 in all districts, that supervisors, not schools, collect on it the attendance of heads, teachers and pupils and information on school councils, management and learning, and that there are difficulties in using it.
title: Relatório da Reunião Anual de Revisão (RAR)
publisher: Ministério da Educação e Desenvolvimento Humano
